summary: Tested all requested UI flows: contractor multi-specialities create/edit, intervention with strict prestataire filter by equipment type, technician dropdown (admin: all users + allowCustom), full intervention creation with prestataire display in detail, and Budget forecast generation + Excel export download. Found and fixed one blocking bug in Contractors.jsx (missing import) that prevented specialities from loading. All flows now pass with 0 console errors.

issues: ResizeObserver loop overlay occasionally appears in preview (non blocking, CRA dev-only).

action_items: Verify the fix applied by testing agent (added `equipmentTypesAPI` to imports in /app/frontend/src/pages/Contractors.jsx) — without it, the Prestataires page threw 'ReferenceError: equipmentTypesAPI is not defined', the specialities badge grid was empty and contractor creation could not carry specialities.
Consider deleting the two seed contractors TEST_Prest_Comp_A and TEST_Prest_Comp_B and the test intervention 'TEST curative motif' created during testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Contractors.jsx used equipmentTypesAPI but did not import it — clear regression from a recent refactor; fixed by testing agent.
In Contractors.jsx row action dropdown, edit/delete menu items and the trigger button lack data-testid (edit-contractor-{id}, delete-contractor-{id}) — makes automation and future testing fragile.

specialite-toggle-{type} testids include spaces/accents (e.g. `specialite-toggle-Cuve à incendie`) — works with quoted attribute selectors but slugified ids would be safer for CSS selectors and links.

One curative intervention titled 'TEST curative motif' linked to COMP_BAUER 01 with prestataire TEST_Prest_Comp_B and custom technician 'TESTUSER_Custom'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified end-to-end: (1) POST contractor with specialites: [Compresseur, Cuve à incendie] persists; table renders both badges in 'Spécialité' column. (2) Edit reopens with badges pre-active (bg-teal-600). Toggle off Cuve then save → row updates to Compresseur only. (3) Interventions modal — selecting equipment 'COMP_BAUER 01 (Compresseur)' filters interv-prestataire-select strictly to prestataires whose specialites includes 'Compresseur' (only TEST_Prest_Comp_B appeared). (4) interv-technicien-select as admin listed 4 users and allowCustom worked ('Utiliser « TESTUSER_Custom »' option shown and selectable). (5) Intervention saved, appears in list; detail view contains 'Prestataire: TEST_Prest_Comp_B'. (6) /budget: generate-forecast-btn triggers forecast, export-forecast-btn downloads budget_previsionnel_2026.xlsx successfully. 0 console errors after the fix.
rca of the issue: Contractors.jsx was refactored to fetch equipment types via equipmentTypesAPI.getAll() at line 116 but the API was not added to the import statement (line 2 only had `contractorsAPI`). Result: fetchContractors() threw ReferenceError, contractors list was never set, equipmentTypes stayed empty, specialite toggles did not render, and the specialite feature was unusable. Fix: `import { contractorsAPI, equipmentTypesAPI } from '../lib/api';`. Reproduction: login as admin → /prestataires → Uncaught runtime error overlay + empty contractors table + empty specialite badges area on new/edit modal.
